name: rarity-ig-designer
title_zh: 每张幻灯片都是独立高清照片的 IG 帖生成器
tagline_zh: 把内容简报变成全出血高清图帖，每页都是独立照片，衬线标题配品红斜体，不靠 Canva 不靠 Figma。
tagline_en: Turns a brief into a full-bleed IG carousel—each slide a distinct photo, serif headlines with magenta italics.
desc_en: Turns a Rarity IG Content Idea Brief into the actual Instagram ART, rendered 100% by Claude in Python/Pillow with NO design connectors (never Canva, never Figma). Every slide is its OWN distinct, current, high-res, high-impact photo full-bleed (no flat, solid, or gradient cards), with a high-contrast editorial SERIF headline (Playfair Display) and italic accent words in magenta, the Rarity symbol
why_zh: 不用任何设计连接器，纯代码出图，每页照片级质感且互不重复，品牌符号自动嵌入。
why_en: No Canva, no Figma—pure Python/Pillow. Every slide is a unique, photo-real, full-bleed image with brand serif + magenta accents.
limit_zh: 只认 Rarity 品牌简报格式，输入必须是该模板的 Idea Brief；产物是方形/纵向静态图，不支持视频或动效。
limit_en: Only accepts Rarity's Idea Brief template; outputs static square/vertical images only—no video/motion; requires Playfair Display font installed.
title_en: IG carousel where every slide is its own photo
